filing_office: Oregon Secretary of State, Corporation Division
filing_fee_notes: Domestic LLC base fee; the fee schedule lists a different amount for foreign LLC authorization.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain an individual or registered business at an Oregon street address suitable for personal delivery. The LLC cannot be its own agent. P.O. boxes, commercial mail receiving agencies, forwarding businesses and virtual offices are prohibited.
standard_processing_time: The SOS says review typically begins within one business day of online submission; it does not promise completion within that time.
annual_report_due: On the anniversary date of the original filing each year.
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and maintain an Oregon registered agent. Renew the registration every year on its anniversary.
common_mistake: Do not list a virtual office as the registered agent's address.
notes: Scope: ordinary domestic LLC. Formation and report URLs are official service gateways. The processing statement describes when review begins, not approval time. Expedited options, franchise or privilege tax treatment, publication requirements and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
